items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Yeah I knew him well, real well. I knew him real well. I knew him from down in the Ninth Ward where I was raised.

ctx.x: Did you know Rene Baptiste and that bass player? Rene Baptiste, I know his name but I don't know him.

Big Dauphine player. Big Eye Louie, do you know him? Yeah I knew him well, real well. I knew him real well. Oh you knew him. Yeah, Big Eye Louie, he used to live, before he died he lived right around here on Dauphine by Calrott Street. But I knew him real well. I knew him from down in the Ninth Ward where I was raised.
He was down there in the Ninth Ward sometimes? Yeah. Yeah.
